rightsReview.finding: The earlier generated-asset review remains byte-bound. Four retained font files now have exact official-upstream byte matches and adjacent OFL-1.1 evidence. Five artwork files have repository-owner originality assertions recorded separately from independent evidence; only the selected Hivra logo has an independently verified owner-supplied original byte match. Eleven token-image, listing-logo and app-icon files are resized exports of that logo and carry its assertion. Two launch-banner drafts are composites of the logo and the owner-asserted litepaper artwork and carry both assertions. No missing prompts, generation tools, or receipts are inferred.
rightsReview.publicSnapshotBasis: Retained asset bytes are also bound to the first public root commit; original creation, generation and licensing evidence remains in the corresponding origin records. This is a public snapshot identity, not a new authorship claim.
